text: From the moment I first saw Heather’s work on Instagram several years ago, I knew I needed her to paint my wedding in the future. So, when we got engaged in September 2021, I booked our venue and then immediately secured Heather for our NYE 2022 wedding!! From the very first conversation with Heather to our last, she was friendly and so easy to work with, not to mention insanely talented. She was the perfect addition to our wedding day! She captured our genuine emotions and the true joy we felt so perfectly. Not only was our painting even better than I could have ever imagined (and I had some high expectations), but our wedding guests had a blast watching her work during the reception. She does an amazing job of engaging with guests and adding the perfect amount of entertainment. She grabs every single little detail from your day and brings it all to life on the canvas, and we had our finished painting back within a month of our wedding! It was an honor having Heather play such an important role in our wedding, and we will cherish our painting forever. I couldn’t recommend her more, so if you’re considering hiring her… DO IT! Truly one of the best decisions we made for our wedding.

owner_reply.text: Amanda!! I had a wonderful time celebrating NYE with your wedding party!! Thank you sooo much for your sweet words!! I wish you a lifetime of happiness!! 💗💗
